description: Manage local Docker from the sidebar — containers, images, volumes, networks, and the current project's Dockerfiles and compose files. Builds stream to a terminal tab; running services open a tab with live logs and a preview of what they serve.
author: Risa Labs

definedPermissions.name: docker.manage
definedPermissions.description: Let agents change Docker state: build images, start, stop, restart and remove containers, and bring compose projects up and down
